result.instructions: Tools for Spectora, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which inspections do we have booked for this week?"; "Show me the agents who referred the most inspections this year."; "Find the inspections in Austin, TX from the last 30 days that are still unpaid.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Spectora data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run spectora_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run spectora_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run spectora_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. spectora_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: spectora_list_inspections
tools.title: List inspections
tools.description: List inspections for your company, with filters for date range, status, inspector, service and location. Canceled, deleted and archived inspections are excluded unless you ask for them. Spectora API: GET /v2/inspections.

sort.description: Sort field: datetime, quote, confirmed or cancel reason. Prefix with '-' for descending.

datetime_greater_than.description: Only inspections after this date or date-time.

datetime_less_than.description: Only inspections before this date or date-time.

connection_id.description: Only inspections for this agent (connection id).

inspector_ids.description: Only inspections for these inspector ids.

service_ids.description: Only inspections for these service ids.

include.description: Comma-separated relationships to include in the response (for example: buyer,property,inspection_notes).

tools.name: spectora_get_inspection
tools.title: Get an inspection
tools.description: Get one inspection by id, optionally with related records (buyer, property, custom fields). Spectora API: GET /v2/inspections/{id}.

include.description: Comma-separated relationships to include in the response (for example: buyer,property,inspection_notes).

tools.name: spectora_list_inspection_attachments
tools.title: List inspection attachments
tools.description: List files attached to inspections (for example, reports). Filter by inspection id. Spectora API: GET /v2/inspection_attachments.

inspection_id.description: Only attachments of this inspection id.

tools.name: spectora_list_availabilities
tools.title: List inspector availability
tools.description: Find open inspector time slots for a date range of up to one month, for the services you want to book. Use it before creating an inspection to offer a real time. Slots ignore service areas and lead time. Spectora API: GET /v2/availabilities.

start_date.description: First day of the range, YYYY-MM-DD.

end_date.description: Last day of the range, YYYY-MM-DD. At most one month after start_date.

service_ids.description: Service ids to book. Slot length follows their base durations.

service_add_on_ids.description: Add-on ids to include in the slot length.

duration.description: Slot length in hours. Send only if the booking will not match its services.

tools.name: spectora_list_contacts
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: List clients (Spectora calls them contacts) for your company. Filter by full-text search, tag or buyer id. Spectora API: GET /v2/contacts.

tags.description: Only clients with all of these tags.

sort.description: Sort field: first_name, last_name or last_first_name. Prefix with '-' for descending.

tools.name: spectora_get_contact
tools.title: Get a client
tools.description: Get one client (contact) by id. Spectora API: GET /v2/contacts/{id}.

tools.name: spectora_create_contact
tools.title: Create a client
tools.description: Create a client (contact) in your company. Creates a new record each time, so check spectora_list_contacts first. Spectora API: POST /v2/contacts.

email.description: Client email. Cannot be changed on update.

private_notes.description: Notes visible only to your company.

tools.name: spectora_update_contact
tools.title: Update a client
tools.description: Update fields of one client (contact). Only the fields you send change. The email cannot be changed here. Spectora API: PUT /v2/contacts/{id}.

private_notes.description: Notes visible only to your company.

tools.name: spectora_list_agents
tools.title: List agents
tools.description: List real estate agents (Spectora calls them connections) that refer your inspections. Filter by full-text search, email, agency or tag. Spectora API: GET /v2/connections.

fulltext.description: Full-text search across agent and agency names.

email.description: Only the agent with this email.

tags.description: Only agents with all of these tags.

sort.description: Sort field. Prefix with '-' for descending.

tools.name: spectora_get_agent
tools.title: Get an agent
tools.description: Get one agent (connection) by connection id. Spectora API: GET /v2/connections/{id}.

tools.name: spectora_get_agent_stats
tools.title: Get agent statistics
tools.description: Get aggregated referral and inspection statistics per agent, for scorecards and referral tracking. Spectora API: GET /v2/connection_stats.

inspection_datetime_greater_than.description: An ISO 8601 date or date-time, e.g. 2026-11-01 or 2026-11-01T09:00:00Z.

inspection_datetime_less_than.description: An ISO 8601 date or date-time, e.g. 2026-11-01 or 2026-11-01T09:00:00Z.

sort.description: Sort field. Prefix with '-' for descending.

tools.name: spectora_list_inspectors
tools.title: List inspectors
tools.description: List the inspectors on your staff, with an active filter. Spectora API: GET /v2/inspectors.

tools.name: spectora_get_inspector
tools.title: Get an inspector
tools.description: Get one inspector by id. Spectora API: GET /v2/inspectors/{id}.

tools.name: spectora_list_services
tools.title: List services
tools.description: List the services your company offers for inspections. Spectora API: GET /v2/services.

sort.description: Sort field. Prefix with '-' for descending.

tools.name: spectora_list_events
tools.title: List calendar events
tools.description: List calendar events for your company. Filter by inspection, inspector, event type or start date range. Spectora API: GET /v2/events.

start_datetime_between.description: Two ISO 8601 date-times: from and to.

include.description: Comma-separated relationships to include in the response (for example: buyer,property,inspection_notes).
